texts.title: Saving energy at home: four points of view

paragraphs.text: With energy bills rising, many households are looking for ways to use less. Energy adviser Karen Liu says the cheapest step is to lower the heating by one degree, which most people do not notice but which can cut a heating bill by around ten per cent.

Builder Tom Evans believes insulation matters more than anything else. He points out that in older houses much of the heat escapes through the roof, and that insulating a loft usually pays for itself within three years.

Consumer journalist Sara Mendes warns people to be careful with energy-saving products sold online. She has tested several devices that claim to cut electricity use and found that most made no measurable difference.

The Green Homes Council, a charity, focuses on households that cannot afford improvements. It offers free home visits and small grants, and it has asked the government to fund insulation for low-income families.
Evans adds that people should replace old boilers before spending money on smaller gadgets, while Mendes advises checking independent reviews before buying any new product.

items.quote: the cheapest step is to lower the heating by one degree
items.prompt: says a small change in temperature can save money

explanation.en: Liu: lower the heating “by one degree” and cut the bill by about ten per cent → A.
explanation.kk: Лю: жылытуды «by one degree» азайтса, шот шамамен 10 %-ға кемиді → A.
explanation.ru: Лю: понизить отопление «by one degree», и счёт уменьшится примерно на 10 % → A.

items.quote: She has tested several devices that claim to cut electricity use
items.prompt: has checked whether some products really work

explanation.en: Mendes “has tested several devices” and found most made no difference → C.
explanation.kk: Мендес «has tested several devices», көбі көмектеспейтінін анықтаған → C.
explanation.ru: Мендес «has tested several devices» и нашла, что большинство не помогает → C.

items.quote: It offers free home visits and small grants
items.prompt: gives people money to make improvements

explanation.en: The charity gives money for improvements: “It offers free home visits and small grants”. Grants are the “money” → D.
explanation.kk: Жақсартуға ақшаны қайырымдылық ұйымы береді: «It offers free home visits and small grants». Грант — «money» деген сол → D.
explanation.ru: Деньги на улучшения даёт благотворительная организация: «It offers free home visits and small grants». Гранты — это и есть «money» → D.

items.quote: in older houses much of the heat escapes through the roof
items.prompt: says heat escapes through the top of older houses

explanation.en: Builder Evans explains that in older houses “much of the heat escapes through the roof”. “The top” = “the roof” → B.
explanation.kk: Құрылысшы Эванс ескі үйлерде «much of the heat escapes through the roof» дейді. «The top of older houses» = «the roof» → B.
explanation.ru: Строитель Эванс объясняет, что в старых домах «much of the heat escapes through the roof». «The top of older houses» = «the roof» → B.

items.quote: Mendes advises checking independent reviews before buying any new product
items.prompt: recommends reading reviews by independent sources

explanation.en: In the last paragraph: “Mendes advises checking independent reviews” → C. Evans, in the same sentence, talks about boilers.
explanation.kk: Соңғы абзацта: «Mendes advises checking independent reviews» → C. Сол сөйлемде Эванс қазандық туралы айтады.
explanation.ru: В последнем абзаце: «Mendes advises checking independent reviews» → C. Эванс в том же предложении говорит о котлах.

items.quote: it has asked the government to fund insulation for low-income families
items.prompt: wants public money spent on insulating poorer homes

explanation.en: The charity “has asked the government to fund insulation for low-income families” → D. Evans praises insulation but says nothing about public money.
explanation.kk: Қайырымдылық ұйымы «has asked the government to fund insulation for low-income families» → D. Эванс жылуды оқшаулауды мақтайды, бірақ мемлекет ақшасы туралы айтпайды.
explanation.ru: Благотворительная организация «has asked the government to fund insulation for low-income families» → D. Эванс хвалит утепление, но о государственных деньгах не говорит.

items.quote: Evans adds that people should replace old boilers before spending money on smaller gadgets
items.prompt: suggests replacing an old heating system before buying gadgets

explanation.en: In the last paragraph Evans says to “replace old boilers before spending money on smaller gadgets”. A boiler is the “heating system” → B.
explanation.kk: Соңғы абзацта Эванс алдымен қазандықты ауыстыруды ұсынады: «replace old boilers before spending money on smaller gadgets». Қазандық — «heating system» → B.
explanation.ru: В последнем абзаце Эванс советует сначала заменить котёл: «replace old boilers before spending money on smaller gadgets». Котёл — это «heating system» → B.

items.quote: which most people do not notice
items.prompt: describes a change that most people will not notice

explanation.en: Lowering the heating by one degree is a change “which most people do not notice” → A.
explanation.kk: Бір градусқа төмендету — «which most people do not notice» өзгеріс → A.
explanation.ru: Понижение на один градус — изменение, «which most people do not notice» → A.

items.quote: insulating a loft usually pays for itself within three years
items.prompt: believes one improvement quickly covers its own cost

explanation.en: Evans: insulating a loft “usually pays for itself within three years” → B.
explanation.kk: Эванс: шатыр астын оқшаулау «usually pays for itself within three years» → B.
explanation.ru: Эванс: утепление чердака «usually pays for itself within three years» → B.

items.quote: It offers free home visits and small grants

explanation.en: The charity “offers free home visits”. No one else on the list visits people at home → D.
explanation.kk: Үйге баруды қайырымдылық ұйымы ұсынады: «It offers free home visits». Тізімдегі басқа ешкім адамдардың үйіне бармайды → D.
explanation.ru: Посещения на дому предлагает благотворительная организация: «It offers free home visits». Никто другой из списка к людям домой не приходит → D.

groups.instruction: Questions 1–10. Look at the following statements and the list of people and organisations below. Match each statement with the correct person or organisation, A–D. NB You may use any letter more than once.
